acceptanceCriteria: Owner consents to the .github/ change and CI retains dated tables, or the gap is recorded as accepted.
body: V1-1584 added `ci-shard-costs refresh --history DIR --keep N`, but the CI workflow does not pass --history, so retained cost tables are only produced locally. Wiring it needs a .github/ workflow change, which requires owner consent.
title: CI shard-cost refresh does not pass --history yet (needs .github/ consent) (V1-1584 residual)
